findings.description: This bucket defines no server_side_encryption_configuration, so every object written to it (including the vendor roster seeded below) is stored unencrypted at rest by default, exposing report data to anyone with access to the underlying storage or its backups.

This bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration, so financial ledger exports are stored unencrypted at rest, allowing plaintext exposure of sensitive records to storage-layer or backup access.
Despite enabling versioning and access logging, this bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration, so model artifact objects are persisted unencrypted at rest.
This bucket defines no server_side_encryption_configuration, so operational runbooks (which frequently contain procedural secrets and infrastructure detail) are stored unencrypted at rest.
This object is uploaded with no server_side_encryption argument and its target bucket defines no default encryption, so the vendor roster file is written to S3 in cleartext at rest.
